_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Claims rejected or underpaid
categories.description: Claims denied, repudiated or only partly paid.

categories.name: Cashless & hospital authorisation
categories.description: Cashless denied, slow pre-authorisation, TPA problems, reimbursement waits.

categories.name: Slow claims & settlement
categories.description: Claims stuck for weeks or months, endless documents.

categories.name: Exclusions, waiting periods & fine print
categories.description: Pre-existing exclusions, waiting periods, room-rent caps, co-pays, deductibles.

categories.name: Premium hikes at renewal
categories.description: Premiums rising sharply at renewal or with age; loyalty penalty.

categories.name: Mis-selling & pushy agents
categories.description: Policies sold under false pretences, bundled or forced insurance.

categories.name: Car & motor claims
categories.description: Accident claims, write-offs, garage disputes, no-claim bonus.
keywords: (car|motor|bike|auto|vehicle) insurance.{0,20}(claim|accident|garage|repair|write|total)|accident claim|write-?off|garage|no claim bonus|\bncb\b|\bidv\b|total loss|not at fault

categories.name: Health cover gaps
categories.description: Out-of-network care, prior authorisation, high deductibles.
keywords: out of network|prior authori[sz]ation|\bhmo\b|\bppo\b|(health|medical) insurance.{0,20}(not cover|doesn.t cover|deductible|copay|denied|rejected|network)|travel insurance.{0,20}(not|medical)

categories.name: Cancellation, lapse & surrender
categories.description: Hard to cancel, surrender losses, lapsed policies, refunds.

categories.name: Support & grievance escalation
categories.description: Unresponsive insurers, ombudsman and regulator complaints.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Family policyholder
personas.description: Insures a family's health or home.

personas.name: Senior citizen
personas.description: Older policyholder or buying for parents.
